value.rationale: The natural robust diameter of effective resistance has a genuine all-size critical edge-price and complete nontrivial optimizer interval with an extremal-selection discontinuity. Unlike a one-line screening bound, this supplies all equality cases, a universal one-sided limit and a meaningful comparison with prior total-resistance and spectral-gap designs.
